entities.summary: Military Order, a political institution in Portugal during County & Kingdom of Portugal (1143–1279). Grew from Treaty of Zamora – Castile recognises Portuguese independence and Treaty of Zamora. Led to the emergence of Reconquista South & Conquest of the Algarve and Siege and capture of Lisbon with Crusader assistance.
